title: Series response
description: Response body of GET /api/series?ra=&dec=&fov=&max_frames=. fov is one of 0.1, 0.2 (default), 0.5, 1 degrees; any other value gives status error. See docs/contract.md. DRAFT: several definitions are open decisions listed there.

status.description: ready: all frames are done or failed. loading: work in progress, poll again. error: the series could not be built.

data_origin.description: real: pixels and metadata come from the SPHEREx archive. simulated: any part is a placeholder or synthetic. The UI must show this label.

total.description: Frames planned for this series: for a live series the `load` asked for (or fewer, if the archive lists fewer images). 0 until the archive query has returned.

failed.description: Frames given up on. Not present in `frames`.

available.description: Optional. Distinct images the archive lists for this position (releases de-duplicated). A live series loads `total` of them and can be asked for more with `load`, up to this many (and at most 102). Present once the archive query has returned; absent for a cached series.

search.description: Optional. Which archive service produced the list of images for a live series: `tap` (the usual, complete list) or `sia2` (the fallback used when TAP failed; the list may be incomplete, see docs/contract.md). Absent for a cached series and until the archive query has returned.

grid.description: The one north-up grid every frame is resampled onto. May be null unless status is ready.

stretch.description: The one intensity mapping already applied to every frame PNG in `frames` (stack images carry their own per-band stretch). May be null unless status is ready.

frames.description: Frames available so far, ordered by index.

error.description: Present only when status is error.

background.description: What was removed from every image before stretching. median_subtracted: each image had the median of its unflagged pixels subtracted, so stretch limits are relative to that background. Absent means none.

photometry.description: Optional (T29). How `frames[].flux` was measured. Present when any frame has a flux.

method.description: Circular aperture photometry on the archive cutout (about 6 arcsec pixels), background from the median of a ring around the aperture.

aperture_corrected.description: False: the flux is the part of the source that falls inside the aperture, so it is a lower limit for a point source.

at.description: Where the aperture is placed in every frame: the requested position, fixed in the sky. A moving target is not followed and is off-centre in frames from other epochs.

stacks.description: Optional. Images combined per visit (a group of observation dates) and per band. Present when status is ready; while a live series is being extended with more frames (status loading) it still carries the stacks of the frames loaded before, until the new ones are built. See docs/contract.md, Stacks.

center.description: ICRS degrees. Equals the request ra/dec.

pixel_scale_arcsec.description: Arcseconds per grid pixel. Fixed in this contract version.

index.description: Position in the planned series, 0-based. Gaps mark failed frames.

url.description: Location of the frame's 8-bit PNG on the API origin.

flag_fraction.description: Fraction of grid pixels that are flagged, 0 to 1.

mjd_avg.description: Optional (T29). MJD of the middle of the exposure, the MJD-AVG keyword of the archive image, when the file has it. obs_mjd stays the archive query's time_bounds_lower. Which of the two is the better time for a light curve is an open decision (docs/contract.md, Flux).

flux.description: Optional (T29). Aperture flux at the grid centre (the requested position), measured on the archive cutout before resampling. See the top-level `photometry` for the method. Present on every frame of a series built after T29; absent in older files. When ok is false there is no flux and `reason` says why.

flux_ujy.description: Flux in microjansky: the background-subtracted sum over the aperture. Not aperture-corrected. May be negative or zero for a faint or absent source.

flux_err_ujy.description: 1 sigma uncertainty in microjansky: the VARIANCE extension summed over the aperture plus the uncertainty of the background level.

reason.description: Why there is no flux. aperture_flagged: a pixel of the aperture is not finite or carries a flag other than SOURCE and FULLSAMPLE (bright stars give this: saturation and blooming flags). aperture_off_image: the aperture is not fully on the cutout. background_too_few_pixels: fewer clean pixels in the background ring than needed. unexpected_unit: the image is not in MJy/sr.

start_mjd.description: Earliest obs_mjd of the images in this visit.

end_mjd.description: Latest obs_mjd of the images in this visit.

bands.description: Band groups. `all` combines every image of a visit; any other id is the archive detector band name with the 'SPHEREx-' prefix removed.

wavelength_min_um.description: Smallest wavelength_um among the images combined in this band.

stretch.description: The mapping applied to this band's stack PNGs, shared by all visits.

diff_limit.description: Difference PNGs of this band map -diff_limit to 0 and +diff_limit to 255, linearly, in stretch.unit. Present only if the band has difference images.

images.description: One per (visit, band) that has at least one image.

url.description: 8-bit PNG of the combined image, band stretch applied.

flag_fraction.description: Fraction of grid pixels where no combined image had an unflagged value, 0 to 1.

diff_url.description: 8-bit PNG of this image minus the same band's earliest visit image. Absent for that earliest image.
